criteria.requirement: Add icecream.builtins.managed_install(name="ic",debugger=None) and already-installed BuiltinInstallation handle/context, leaving original install/uninstall unchanged. Record previous value and ownership tokens, restore/remove only when the current binding still belongs to this installation, and leave foreign replacements untouched. Support same/different debugger nested installs, idempotent and out-of-order close without resurrecting closed ancestors, exception cleanup and rejection of closed reentry/invalid identifiers/keywords/wrong debugger. Never scan other builtins; all verification uses synthetic names, not print or production globals.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
